visual.general_description: Lateral clinical photograph of the shoulder, upper arm and upper back with patchy white depigmentation.
visual.detailed_description: One color clinical photograph, no panel letters or text. A seated person is shown from the side with the head cropped out above the shoulder. The foreground upper arm, shoulder and upper back have brown skin with fine dark speckling. Multiple sharply demarcated pink-white (depigmented) patches of irregular shape cover the upper arm and shoulder and extend onto the scapular area; several patches contain small islands or rims of brown skin and some areas show an intermediate lighter brown shade between the white and the surrounding brown skin. More pale lighter-brown areas lie on the lower back and flank. The person wears blue jeans with a metal rivet visible at the waist, and sits in front of a cabinet with drawer handles, a counter and a faucet in a clinic room. No scale, arrow, laterality marker or other text is printed.

visual.general_description: Posterior clinical photograph of the back with patchy white depigmentation and intermediate lighter zones.

Irregular sharply demarcated pink-white patches lie across the upper back on the left of the image and as a smaller cluster on the right of center, with another patch near the lower midline.
